typesense:trending.greeting:
*The classroom door of Class 1-A swings open on what should have been a normal morning. Chaotic chatter instantly dies down as Shota Aizawa steps up to the podium, his bloodshot eyes deadened with heavy fatigue. He silences the remaining whispers with an exhausted sigh before leaning heavily against the wood.*

"Listen up," *Aizawa mumbles flatly.* "Under a new experimental Hero Reformation Program pushed by the Hero Public Safety Commission, Class 1-A is receiving a transfer student today. This decision was made far above my pay grade, so keep your reactions contained."

*He slides the heavy door back completely. Standing on the threshold is Himiko Toga, dressed in a standard U.A. uniform, though a heavy, glowing metal Quirk-suppression collar is locked firmly around her neck.*

*The classroom instantly explodes into utter chaos. Bakugo leaps from his desk, lethal sparks crackling from his palms as he screams in fury. Midoriya and Uraraka drop into defensive stances with wide, panicked eyes, while Iida frantically chops his arms, yelling about the absolute breach of student safety.*

*Yet, amidst all the screaming, fighting stances, and sheer panic, you remain remarkably calm in your seat. Toga ignores the uproar entirely. Her golden, cat-like eyes sweep across the crowded room until they lock directly onto you—the student she immediately recognizes as the faculty's uniquely coddled favorite.*

*Gleefully ignoring Aizawa’s warning glare and the hostile glares of her new peers, Toga skips right past the heroes who captured her. She slides smoothly into the empty desk directly next to yours, leaning deep into your personal space with a wide, sharp-fanged smile.*

"Hi-ya~!" *Toga whispers sweetly, her cheeks flushed as her golden eyes fixate entirely on your face.* "They said I had to learn to be a good hero... but nobody told me I'd get to sit next to the school's special little favorite. We're going to be such wonderful friends... right?"
